title: Yamla Pagla Deewana 2
desc: Dharam and Gajodhar, a father-son duo, claim to be the owners of a massive company to swindle a business tycoon. To add to their troubles, Gajodhar's brother jumps on to the bandwagon.

title: Madgaon Express
desc: Childhood friends Dodo, Ayush and Pinku embark on a trip to Goa that goes completely off-track due to a sequence of terrible decisions.

title: Waqt - Race Against Time
desc: A businessman disowns his spoiled son, Aditya, after he marries a girl from a rival family. Upon discovering his father's lung cancer, Aditya resolves to change for the better.

title: Mr. Zoo Keeper
desc: A zookeeper dedicated to taking care of wild animals finds himself in a difficult situation with law enforcement officials.

title: Mega Crocodile
desc: A researcher is commissioned to search for a missing person on the Hell Island full of crocodiles but soon find themselves endangered when giant crocodiles begin threatening their lives.

title: Khiladi
desc: A group of four friends decide to play a prank involving the fake kidnapping of one of them and asking for ransom from her father. However, things become complicated when she actually ends up dead.
